name: Marketing Council
subtitle: Marketing strategy council
description: Diagnose the marketing problem before choosing tactics. Marketing Council connects established marketing schools, principles, and applied theories to specialist agents, evidence gates, commercial checks, and measurable actions.
starter_prompts: Diagnose this marketing problem before recommending tactics.
Run a council debate on this strategy and tell me what decision the evidence supports.
Red-team this marketing plan, then rebuild the parts that would fail commercially.
